verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence addresses AI model training policy or an opt-out. The closest support is indirect: BugSnag On-premise lets organizations self-host and manage their own data, keeping it out of the vendor's hands, and data-management tools allow redacting or removing sensitive data retroactively. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that customer data is not used for AI training, a documented opt-out control for the hosted SaaS, and independent corroboration of the training-data policy.
